execution: Local Python312 plus Git Bash; dependency-mocked actual production shell state machine
boundaries: No adb, headset, ptrace, network, or real process signals. OS process identity, properties, checksum/native responses, sleep and signal effects are controlled fixtures.
covered: Clean owned stop restores stock and clears active lease
External active patch refused without adoption or restoration
Disabled Action reports external active patch explicitly
Disabled resume never starts or queries native target
Interrupted old-boot lease quarantines automatic resume
Service restart disables without retry
Runtime health error disables without retry
Native owner death disables without retry
Checksum failure prevents activation
Cancellation while waiting for boot prevents activation
Disable during launch immediately restores owned helper
Stopped owned helper receives TERM then CONT, never target signals
Stuck owner preserves quarantine and reports failure
Unverified restoration preserves quarantine and reports failure
Wrong executable identity receives no signal
Reused owner PID/start identity receives no signal
Default Action dispatches status only and explains saved-checkbox/soft-reboot behavior
Explicit Action on dispatches enable directly
Explicit Action off dispatches disable directly
Explicit Action status dispatches status directly
limits: Mocks validate shell decisions, ownership checks and failure handling. They do not replace native parent-death/guardian tests, Android shell validation, or user-visible tracking evaluation. Module was not activated by these tests.
control: Standard KernelSU 1.0 service stage; status-only Action; explicit on/off directly dispatch lifecycle
